privacy_policy: No user prompts, account data, credentials or private task content stored in this ledger.

rules.why: No substantial specialist value; preserve direct concise reply.
rules.skip_if: Never invent Registry/tool calls to justify any skill.

intent_examples: Revise o fluxo de navegação deste dashboard
A tela está confusa no celular
rules.why: Audit observed task states, access and proportional correction before aesthetic polish.
rules.skip_if: Only backend API/data logic is involved; no visible user task or UI.
rules.evidence_required: real host-listed specialist URI and SKILL read to claim specialist applied

intent_examples: A página está boa; há algo pequeno para aprimorar?
rules.why: Distinguish retain, targeted correction and systemic redesign; preserve approved brand and features.
rules.skip_if: No artifact is supplied and the user requests proof of specific screen defects.
rules.evidence_required: screen/source actually inspected or hypothesis explicitly marked

intent_examples: No japonês, Enter está enviando o formulário durante a composição
Verifique o layout RTL do aplicativo
rules.why: Validate platform-specific focus, native touch, text reflow, logical direction and IME behavior.
rules.skip_if: The request is only translation of isolated prose, without UI behavior.
rules.evidence_required: exact platform and evidence scope; simulated checks do not prove device compatibility

intent_examples: Melhore os textos dos botões deste formulário
Reescreva +12% de crescimento sem inventar o comparador
rules.why: Preserve action meaning and metric denominator, units, evidence and user tone.
rules.skip_if: The user asks a purely visual layout question with no copy or factual claims.
rules.evidence_required: source text and factual basis for new claims

intent_examples: Troque poderá por deverá neste contrato
Melhore este texto sem mudar o compromisso
rules.why: Prevent hidden changes in certainty, negation, consent, amount or deadlines; warn before material alternative.
rules.skip_if: The task is purely visual or programmatic and needs no text revision.
rules.evidence_required: original vs revised semantic invariants verified before copyable draft

intent_examples: Revise a experiência do formulário e as mensagens de erro
rules.why: UX owns states and accessibility; Text owns language, claims and meaning. Use each only when needed and available.
rules.skip_if: One specialist suffices or a simple native response fully solves the task.
rules.evidence_required: separate real source reads; do not infer both activated from a shared plan

intent_examples: Crie tokens e uma identidade reutilizável para o produto
rules.why: Design System Studio owns visual identity but is not one of six installed Web Labs Skills; never claim it was loaded from this plugin.
rules.skip_if: User requests only UX audit, not a reusable visual system.
rules.evidence_required: actual external skill availability/read before claiming Design System Studio used

intent_examples: Corrija falhas no endpoint PHP sem mudar a interface
rules.why: Use engineering investigation, never misroute to UX polish.
rules.skip_if: An actual UI interaction defect is also present and material.
rules.evidence_required: real engineering specialist URI/read when claimed
